verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for an AI model product, since vendors can release downloadable weights. Every item in the pack describes Grok as a hosted xAI API: regional endpoints, ZDR, and access through Google Vertex AI or Microsoft Foundry. Third-party managed cloud access is not self-hosting, and nothing documents downloadable weights or on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
